contract: A23-87: FlowerSlime (meadow, Ambush Salt / Pop 8: Hidden attribute until a player it may chase is within Pop or it is hit, then Hidden false + PopAt + a Spot bark), SlingshotGoblin (woods) and SkeletonArcher (ruins, PartnerOf SkeletonKnight: 4-8 studs from a knight without an archer) with Ranged { Range, Stand, Windup, Speed, Radius, Cooldown }: in range it stands, faces and winds up (WindupAt), then Fx MonsterShot { Id, Kind, From, To, Speed, Radius, Travel } to all; after Travel s the target only is hit when still within Radius of To (Y within 6) and still a valid target; out of range at the release = no shot. Damage under the zone's melee kind. KillCards.FlowerPatch: a Flower Slime kill offers ChoiceCard FlowerPatch with Chance, at most once per 600 s a player (only an opened card starts the cooldown).
limitations: MonsterService's aiStep / spawnMonster / DamageMonster hooks are checked as source text; the AI loop, ground rays, CombatService and ChoiceCard are doubles; the client (shot drawing, pop sparkle, hidden nametag) is game dev 1's.
